name: modern-azure-bicep-best-practices
description: Professional modern Azure Bicep engineering best practices covering modular architecture & AVM, User-Defined Types (UDT) and .bicepparam parameter files, zero-secrets security & Managed Identity RBAC, Container Apps & Jobs microservice topologies, Cosmos DB MongoDB API autoscale throughput governance, API Management external VNet & XML policies (rate limiting, Entra ID JWT, RFC 6648 idempotency), Azure Monitor Workbooks & FinOps telemetry, Azure Deployment Stacks lifecycle & drift governance, multi-gate CI/CD with OIDC, PSRule/linter validation, and mandatory living README.md runbook documentation discipline.
